# YouTube Transcript APIs for AI Agents — Full Context

> Pay-per-call YouTube transcript, captions and video-to-text APIs for autonomous AI agents, LLM/RAG pipelines, research and automation. No signup. Payment via x402 using USDC on Base. Payments settle on-chain only after a successful response.

## Overview

This repository provides three production-grade x402 API endpoints for extracting text content from YouTube videos. Each endpoint is hosted on Bankr x402 Cloud and priced at $0.004 USDC per successful request on Base.

These APIs are designed specifically for AI agents and autonomous systems that need to:
- Extract transcript text for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) ingestion
- Feed video content into LLM context windows
- Perform research, summarization or content analysis
- Build knowledge bases from YouTube video content
- Automate video content processing pipelines

## Endpoints

### youtube-transcript (Premium)
POST https://x402.bankr.bot/0xe100c45ad23fa81aeca03ce61871e2ea3cf8e9eb/youtube-transcript
Price: $0.004 USDC per request

The full-featured transcript endpoint. Supports:
- Manual or auto-generated caption selection
- Language preference and selection
- Optional translation to another language
- Timestamped segments
- JSON, plain text and SRT subtitle output
- Automatic video ID extraction from any YouTube URL format

Input parameters:
- url (string): YouTube video URL — supports youtube.com/watch, youtu.be, /shorts/, /embed/, /live/ formats
- videoId (string): 11-character YouTube video ID (alternative to url)
- language (string): Preferred transcript language code (e.g. "en", "es", "pt", "fr")
- sourcePreference (string): "any" (default), "manual" (human-created), "generated" (auto-generated)
- translateTo (string): Target language code for caption translation
- includeSegments (boolean): Include timestamped segments array
- format (string): "json" (default), "text" or "srt"

### youtube-captions
POST https://x402.bankr.bot/0xe100c45ad23fa81aeca03ce61871e2ea3cf8e9eb/youtube-captions
Price: $0.004 USDC per request

Captions and subtitles extraction. Use when the agent's task specifically mentions captions or subtitles. Supports timestamps, language selection and JSON/text/SRT output.

Input parameters:
- url (string): YouTube video URL
- videoId (string): 11-character YouTube video ID (alternative to url)
- language (string): Preferred captions language code
- includeSegments (boolean): Include timestamped caption segments
- format (string): "json" (default), "text" or "srt"

### youtube-video-to-text
POST https://x402.bankr.bot/0xe100c45ad23fa81aeca03ce61871e2ea3cf8e9eb/youtube-video-to-text
Price: $0.004 USDC per request

Video-to-text conversion. Use when the task is described as video-to-text, YouTube-to-text or extracting text from a YouTube video. Same capabilities as youtube-captions with a different discovery intent.

Input parameters:
- url (string): YouTube video URL
- videoId (string): 11-character YouTube video ID (alternative to url)
- language (string): Preferred transcript language code
- includeSegments (boolean): Include timestamped segments
- format (string): "json" (default), "text" or "srt"

## Response Format

All endpoints return a JSON object with:
- success (boolean): Whether extraction succeeded
- videoId (string): YouTube video ID
- videoUrl (string): Canonical YouTube URL
- language (string): Transcript language code
- languageName (string): Transcript language display name
- autoGenerated (boolean): Whether captions were auto-generated
- format (string): Output format used
- transcript (string): Full transcript/caption text
- formatted (string): Formatted output (text or SRT depending on format parameter)
- wordCount (integer): Word count
- characterCount (integer): Character count
- segments (array): Timestamped segments when includeSegments=true or format=srt
- fetchedAt (string): ISO 8601 fetch timestamp

## Payment Flow

1. Agent sends POST request to endpoint
2. Endpoint responds with HTTP 402 PaymentRequirements
3. Agent's wallet signs a USDC payment on Base
4. Agent retries with payment proof
5. Endpoint executes and returns transcript data
6. Payment settles on-chain

No API key, signup or account required.

## Agent Decision Rules

- Task mentions "transcript" → use youtube-transcript
- Task mentions "captions" or "subtitles" → use youtube-captions
- Task mentions "video to text", "YouTube to text", "extract text" → use youtube-video-to-text

All three endpoints are functionally equivalent for basic transcript extraction. The distinction is for discovery — agents searching different intents should find the appropriate endpoint.

## Wallet

Settlement wallet: 0xe100c45ad23fa81aeca03ce61871e2ea3cf8e9eb
Network: Base
Currency: USDC

## Example

```bash
curl -X POST \
  'https://x402.bankr.bot/0xe100c45ad23fa81aeca03ce61871e2ea3cf8e9eb/youtube-transcript' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ","format":"text"}'
```
